review.imagery: 33 gallery entries include 13 dated site photographs. All eighteen primary assets, the complete 37-page brochure index, 31 native resources and thirteen September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Two repeated/cropped primary roof and facade views, repeated brochure scenes, textures and generic lifestyle images were excluded. Four brochure scenes add full tower, gym and home detail. Home interiors remain developer concepts, some shared within Cove marketing. Site photographs retain their historical date and original project history attribution.
review.floorPlans: All three whole physical plan pages 2–4 were visually reviewed. The grouped sheet explicitly spans levels 2–13. Unit categories and rooftop amenities retain their printed labels. Original broker border, marks and margins remain intact. No individual saleable areas are printed. The inspected Silver Oak page has no open floor-plan section. Three complete building drawings retain the studio, executive studio, 1 BR, executive 1 BR and 2 BR categories. No numerical individual home areas are printed on these drawings. Ground/podium drawings are absent from this packet. Confirm standalone contractual unit sheets, saleable areas and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole brochure map 32 and factsheet map 4 were rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. The factsheet supplies twelve individually printed estimates and is the displayed map/source. The brochure alone provides broad time rings. Current official FAQ group estimates differ and remain qualified. The official named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinates.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction sources retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures, factsheets and plan packets retain their actual broker/design-host attribution. Full sheets, notices and original source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.

unavailable: Standalone contractual unit drawings and saleable areas, ground/podium drawings, resolution of current-versus-earlier travel estimates, exact visitor entrance, current certified progress and final specifications remain unavailable or unverified.
